note: Original SVG hardware illustrations, not product photographs or hardware-test evidence. Manufacturer photographs and CAD were consulted for shape/control layout. Distinct example screens use Pokémon Ruby / Sapphire, DOOM GBA and Celeste Classic 2 game-frame composites, not device captures. The hero uses genuine Mario captures and separately credited SeedSigner splash and Home software previews. Source image bytes and gameplay pixels are unchanged. Each screen uses the full LCD aperture: widescreen content retains its aspect ratio across the LCD width with black letterboxing above and below; the regular display fills its square aperture with Celeste’s native square gameplay area, clipping only black capture padding. Approximate perspective and comparative sizes, not exact scale.
